name: Yoshio Nishina
summary: Japanese physicist known for the Klein-Nishina formula and founding RIKEN's nuclear physics program.

name: Oskar Klein
summary: Swedish theoretical physicist who collaborated with Nishina on Compton scattering.

name: Niels Bohr
summary: Danish physicist who hosted Nishina at the Institute for Theoretical Physics in Copenhagen.

name: P.A.M. Dirac
summary: British physicist who formulated the Dirac equation used in the Klein-Nishina derivation.

name: Walter Gordon
summary: German physicist who independently worked on Compton scattering using the Klein-Gordon equation.

name: I.I. Rabi
summary: American physicist who collaborated with Nishina in Hamburg on X-ray absorption.

name: Hidehiko Tamaki
summary: Japanese physicist who led the investigation group on Nishina's source materials.

name: Nishina Memorial Foundation
summary: Organization preserving Yoshio Nishina's archival materials in Tokyo.

name: University of Copenhagen
summary: University where Nishina studied and worked from 1923 to 1928.

name: RIKEN
summary: Japanese research institute where Nishina was a collaborator and leader.

name: Klein-Nishina formula
summary: Formula for the scattering cross section of a photon by an electron.

name: Dirac equation
summary: Relativistic wave equation for the electron used in the derivation.

name: Zeitschrift für Physik
summary: Physics journal where the Klein-Nishina paper was published.

name: Nature
summary: Scientific journal where Nishina published a note on the formula.

name: Sangokan Nishina Source Materials
summary: Archive of Nishina's documents retained in the Nishina Memorial Foundation.
